name: Pangolin Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0 self-hosted secure networking and reverse-proxy platform with WireGuard-based tunnels, sites, resources and users, using the Community Edition without a software subscription.
watch_out: Requires your own server, DNS, TLS, networking and ongoing maintenance. Community Edition is AGPL-3.0 (comply with source-sharing obligations); SSO, advanced RBAC, audit logs, high availability and other enterprise controls are paid. The free Enterprise personal-use license has separate revenue and eligibility limits and is NOT this plan.
